items.question: Trong câu "The Product Owner has the authority to decide the CONTENT and ORDER of the product backlog, and is accountable for maximising the value the team creates.", từ "authority" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The Product Owner has the authority to decide the CONTENT and ORDER of the product backlog, and is accountable for maximising the value the team creates.", what does "authority" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: authority /ɔːˈθɒr.ə.ti/ (danh từ): quyền quyết định. Have the authority to decide = có quyền quyết định; số nhiều the authorities = nhà chức trách.
items.explanationEn: authority /ɔːˈθɒr.ə.ti/ (noun): the power to make decisions. Have the authority to decide means hold the power to; the authorities means officials.

items.question: Trong câu "The Product Owner has the authority to decide the CONTENT and ORDER of the product backlog, and is accountable for maximising the value the team creates.", từ "accountable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The Product Owner has the authority to decide the CONTENT and ORDER of the product backlog, and is accountable for maximising the value the team creates.", what does "accountable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: accountable /əˈkaʊn.tə.bəl/ (tính từ): chịu trách nhiệm giải trình. Be accountable for something = chịu trách nhiệm cuối cùng về kết quả; danh từ accountability.
items.explanationEn: accountable /əˈkaʊn.tə.bəl/ (adjective): answerable for results. Be accountable for something means you answer for the result; the noun is accountability.

items.question: Trong câu "The Product Owner has the authority to decide the CONTENT and ORDER of the product backlog, and is accountable for maximising the value the team creates.", từ "maximise" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The Product Owner has the authority to decide the CONTENT and ORDER of the product backlog, and is accountable for maximising the value the team creates.", what does "maximise" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to make as large as possible
items.explanation: maximise /ˈmæk.sɪ.maɪz/ (động từ): tối đa hóa. Maximise value/profit = tối đa hóa giá trị/lợi nhuận; trái nghĩa minimise.
items.explanationEn: maximise /ˈmæk.sɪ.maɪz/ (verb): to make as large as possible. Maximise value or profit; the opposite is minimise.

items.question: Trong câu "Authority — a PO must be able to decide, not merely relay other people's opinions.", từ "merely" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Authority — a PO must be able to decide, not merely relay other people's opinions.", what does "merely" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: merely /ˈmɪə.li/ (trạng từ): chỉ đơn thuần. Not merely X = không chỉ đơn thuần là X; tính từ mere (a mere messenger).
items.explanationEn: merely /ˈmɪə.li/ (adverb): only, simply. Not merely X means not just X; the adjective is mere, as in a mere messenger.

items.question: Trong câu "Authority — a PO must be able to decide, not merely relay other people's opinions.", từ "relay" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Authority — a PO must be able to decide, not merely relay other people's opinions.", what does "relay" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to run in a team race
items.explanation: relay /ˈriː.leɪ/ (động từ): chuyển tiếp (thông tin). Relay opinions/a message = chuyển lời, truyền đạt lại ý kiến người khác mà không tự quyết.
items.explanationEn: relay /ˈriː.leɪ/ (verb): to pass on a message. Relay opinions or a message means pass them on without deciding yourself.

items.question: Trong câu "Value — the goal is not shipping the most features but creating the most value.", từ "ship" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Value — the goal is not shipping the most features but creating the most value.", what does "ship" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: ship /ʃɪp/ (động từ): phát hành (sản phẩm). Ship a feature = phát hành tính năng tới người dùng; cụm: ship fast, ship to production.
items.explanationEn: ship /ʃɪp/ (verb): to release a product. Ship a feature means release it to users; e.g. ship fast, ship to production.

items.question: Trong câu "Many organizations get this wrong, and the consequence is a team receiving contradictory direction from several sides with nobody ultimately accountable.", từ "consequence" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Many organizations get this wrong, and the consequence is a team receiving contradictory direction from several sides with nobody ultimately accountable.", what does "consequence" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a result, often a bad one
items.explanation: consequence /ˈkɒn.sɪ.kwəns/ (danh từ): hậu quả. The consequence is... = hậu quả là...; cụm: face the consequences (chịu hậu quả).
items.explanationEn: consequence /ˈkɒn.sɪ.kwəns/ (noun): a result, often a bad one. The consequence is describes the result; phrase: face the consequences.

items.question: Trong câu "Many organizations get this wrong, and the consequence is a team receiving contradictory direction from several sides with nobody ultimately accountable.", từ "contradictory" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Many organizations get this wrong, and the consequence is a team receiving contradictory direction from several sides with nobody ultimately accountable.", what does "contradictory" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: contradictory /ˌkɒn.trəˈdɪk.tər.i/ (tính từ): mâu thuẫn nhau. Contradictory direction/requirements = chỉ đạo/yêu cầu mâu thuẫn; động từ contradict.
items.explanationEn: contradictory /ˌkɒn.trəˈdɪk.tər.i/ (adjective): conflicting with each other. Contradictory direction or requirements conflict; the verb is contradict.

items.question: Trong câu "Many organizations get this wrong, and the consequence is a team receiving contradictory direction from several sides with nobody ultimately accountable.", từ "ultimately" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Many organizations get this wrong, and the consequence is a team receiving contradictory direction from several sides with nobody ultimately accountable.", what does "ultimately" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: ultimately /ˈʌl.tɪ.mət.li/ (trạng từ): rốt cuộc, sau cùng. Ultimately accountable = người chịu trách nhiệm cuối cùng; tính từ ultimate.
items.explanationEn: ultimately /ˈʌl.tɪ.mət.li/ (adverb): in the end, finally. Ultimately accountable means holding final responsibility; the adjective is ultimate.

items.question: Trong câu "A PO is ONE person, not a committee.", từ "committee" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A PO is ONE person, not a committee.", what does "committee" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: committee /kəˈmɪt.i/ (danh từ): hội đồng, ủy ban. A committee = nhóm nhiều người cùng quyết định; đừng nhầm với commitment (cam kết).
items.explanationEn: committee /kəˈmɪt.i/ (noun): a group that decides jointly. A committee is a group deciding together; do not confuse it with commitment.

items.question: Trong câu "Without a vision, every prioritization decision becomes arbitrary.", từ "arbitrary" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Without a vision, every prioritization decision becomes arbitrary.", what does "arbitrary" (adjective) mean?
options: tùy tiện, không có cơ sở
items.explanation: arbitrary /ˈɑː.bɪ.trər.i/ (tính từ): tùy tiện, không có cơ sở. An arbitrary decision = quyết định tùy tiện; trạng từ arbitrarily.
items.explanationEn: arbitrary /ˈɑː.bɪ.trər.i/ (adjective): based on no clear reason. An arbitrary decision has no sound basis; the adverb is arbitrarily.

items.question: Trong câu "It must be ordered, transparent to everyone, and continuously refined.", từ "transparent" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It must be ordered, transparent to everyone, and continuously refined.", what does "transparent" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: transparent /trænˈspær.ənt/ (tính từ): minh bạch, ai cũng thấy. Transparent to everyone = minh bạch với mọi người; danh từ transparency.
items.explanationEn: transparent /trænˈspær.ənt/ (adjective): open and visible to all. Transparent to everyone means open for all to see; the noun is transparency.

items.question: Trong câu "This responsibility cannot be delegated.", từ "delegate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This responsibility cannot be delegated.", what does "delegate" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to hand a duty to another
items.explanation: delegate /ˈdel.ɪ.ɡeɪt/ (động từ): ủy quyền, giao lại. Delegate a task to someone = giao việc cho người khác; danh từ delegate /ˈdel.ɪ.ɡət/ = đại biểu.
items.explanationEn: delegate /ˈdel.ɪ.ɡeɪt/ (verb): to hand a duty to another. Delegate a task to someone; the noun delegate means a representative.

items.question: Trong câu "The team supplies effort estimates; the PO decides the order based on value.", từ "supply" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The team supplies effort estimates; the PO decides the order based on value.", what does "supply" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: supply /səˈplaɪ/ (động từ): cung cấp. Supply estimates/data = cung cấp ước lượng/dữ liệu; cặp đối lập supply and demand.
items.explanationEn: supply /səˈplaɪ/ (verb): to provide. Supply estimates or data means provide them; compare supply and demand.

items.question: Trong câu "Answering questions promptly.", từ "promptly" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Answering questions promptly.", what does "promptly" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: promptly /ˈprɒmpt.li/ (trạng từ): kịp thời, nhanh chóng. Answer/respond promptly = trả lời kịp thời; tính từ prompt.
items.explanationEn: promptly /ˈprɒmpt.li/ (adverb): quickly, without delay. Answer or respond promptly means without delay; the adjective is prompt.

items.question: Trong câu "A PO who is not available forces the team to guess.", từ "available" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A PO who is not available forces the team to guess.", what does "available" (adjective) mean?
options: sẵn sàng, có mặt để hỗ trợ
items.explanation: available /əˈveɪ.lə.bəl/ (tính từ): sẵn sàng, có mặt để hỗ trợ. Be available = có mặt/rảnh để hỗ trợ; danh từ availability.
items.explanationEn: available /əˈveɪ.lə.bəl/ (adjective): free to help when needed. Be available means be reachable and free to help; the noun is availability.

items.question: Trong câu "Accepting or rejecting completed work, against the agreed acceptance criteria.", từ "against" (giới từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Accepting or rejecting completed work, against the agreed acceptance criteria.", what does "against" (preposition) mean?
items.explanation: against /əˈɡenst/ (giới từ): so với, đối chiếu với. Check/accept against the criteria = kiểm tra đối chiếu với tiêu chí.
items.explanationEn: against /əˈɡenst/ (preposition): compared with. Check or accept against the criteria means compare with them.

items.question: Trong câu "Representing the voice of all stakeholders — customers, users, business, operations, compliance.", từ "compliance" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Representing the voice of all stakeholders — customers, users, business, operations, compliance.", what does "compliance" (noun) mean?
options: bộ phận tuân thủ quy định
items.explanation: compliance /kəmˈplaɪ.əns/ (danh từ): bộ phận tuân thủ quy định. Compliance = sự/bộ phận tuân thủ luật và quy định; động từ comply with.
items.explanationEn: compliance /kəmˈplaɪ.əns/ (noun): the rule-following function. Compliance means following laws and rules, or the team that ensures it; the verb is comply with.

items.question: Trong câu "The most underrated responsibility is number 4.", từ "underrated" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The most underrated responsibility is number 4.", what does "underrated" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: underrated /ˌʌn.dəˈreɪ.tɪd/ (tính từ): bị đánh giá thấp. Underrated = bị đánh giá thấp hơn thực tế; trái nghĩa overrated.
items.explanationEn: underrated /ˌʌn.dəˈreɪ.tɪd/ (adjective): valued less than deserved. Underrated means valued less than it deserves; the opposite is overrated.

items.question: Trong câu "Many POs treat their job as writing the backlog and then disappearing.", từ "treat as" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Many POs treat their job as writing the backlog and then disappearing.", what does "treat as" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: treat as /triːt æz/ (cụm từ): coi như, xem là. Treat X as Y = coi X là Y; treat the job as writing the backlog = coi công việc chỉ là viết backlog.
items.explanationEn: treat as /triːt æz/ (phrase): to regard as. Treat X as Y means regard X as Y; e.g. treat the job as writing the backlog.

items.question: Trong câu "This is the number one cause of Scrum team failure.", từ "failure" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This is the number one cause of Scrum team failure.", what does "failure" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: failure /ˈfeɪ.ljər/ (danh từ): sự thất bại. Team failure = sự thất bại của nhóm; failure mode = kiểu thất bại điển hình.
items.explanationEn: failure /ˈfeɪ.ljər/ (noun): a lack of success. Team failure is lack of success; a failure mode is a typical way something fails.

items.question: Trong câu "The team hits an unclear detail, asks a question, and gets no answer that day.", từ "hit" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The team hits an unclear detail, asks a question, and gets no answer that day.", what does "hit" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: hit /hɪt/ (động từ): gặp phải. Hit a problem/an issue = gặp phải vấn đề; nghĩa khác: hit the target (đạt mục tiêu).
items.explanationEn: hit /hɪt/ (verb): to run into a problem. Hit a problem or issue means run into it; another sense is hit the target.

items.question: Trong câu "They have two options: be blocked or guess.", từ "blocked" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "They have two options: be blocked or guess.", what does "blocked" (adjective) mean?
options: bị chặn, không làm tiếp được
items.explanation: blocked /blɒkt/ (tính từ): bị chặn, không làm tiếp được. Be blocked (on something) = bị kẹt, không làm tiếp được; danh từ blocker (vấn đề cản trở).
items.explanationEn: blocked /blɒkt/ (adjective): unable to continue work. Be blocked on something means unable to proceed; the noun blocker names the obstacle.

items.question: Trong câu "Guessing is the worse failure mode, because it is invisible.", từ "invisible" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Guessing is the worse failure mode, because it is invisible.", what does "invisible" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: invisible /ɪnˈvɪz.ə.bəl/ (tính từ): không nhìn thấy được. Invisible problems = vấn đề không lộ ra; trái nghĩa visible.
items.explanationEn: invisible /ɪnˈvɪz.ə.bəl/ (adjective): not able to be seen. Invisible problems are hidden from view; the opposite is visible.

items.question: Trong câu "Being blocked shows up in the daily standup; a wrong guess only surfaces during testing or after delivery — when fixing it costs many times more.", từ "surface" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Being blocked shows up in the daily standup; a wrong guess only surfaces during testing or after delivery — when fixing it costs many times more.", what does "surface" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: surface /ˈsɜː.fɪs/ (động từ): lộ ra, xuất hiện. An issue surfaces = vấn đề lộ ra; danh từ surface = bề mặt.
items.explanationEn: surface /ˈsɜː.fɪs/ (verb): to come to light. An issue surfaces when it becomes known; the noun surface means the top layer.

items.question: Trong câu "Warning signs: Jira questions unanswered beyond 24 hours; the team starting to decide business behaviour themselves; sprint reviews full of surprises.", từ "warning sign" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Warning signs: Jira questions unanswered beyond 24 hours; the team starting to decide business behaviour themselves; sprint reviews full of surprises.", what does "warning sign" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: warning sign /ˈwɔː.nɪŋ saɪn/ (cụm từ): dấu hiệu cảnh báo. Warning signs = dấu hiệu cảnh báo sớm; gần nghĩa: red flags.
items.explanationEn: warning sign /ˈwɔː.nɪŋ saɪn/ (phrase): a sign of possible trouble. Warning signs are early hints of trouble; similar to red flags.

items.question: Trong câu "Warning signs: Jira questions unanswered beyond 24 hours; the team starting to decide business behaviour themselves; sprint reviews full of surprises.", từ "beyond" (giới từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Warning signs: Jira questions unanswered beyond 24 hours; the team starting to decide business behaviour themselves; sprint reviews full of surprises.", what does "beyond" (preposition) mean?
items.explanation: beyond /biˈjɒnd/ (giới từ): quá, vượt quá. Beyond 24 hours = quá 24 giờ; cụm: beyond scope (ngoài phạm vi).
items.explanationEn: beyond /biˈjɒnd/ (preposition): past, more than. Beyond 24 hours means longer than that; phrase: beyond scope.

items.question: Trong câu "They must escalate every decision.", từ "escalate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "They must escalate every decision.", what does "escalate" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to pass up to a higher level
items.explanation: escalate /ˈes.kə.leɪt/ (động từ): đẩy lên cấp trên. Escalate an issue/decision = chuyển vấn đề lên cấp cao hơn xử lý; danh từ escalation.
items.explanationEn: escalate /ˈes.kə.leɪt/ (verb): to pass up to a higher level. Escalate an issue or decision means pass it to someone more senior; the noun is escalation.

items.question: Trong câu "A PO who cannot decide is not a PO — they are a messenger.", từ "messenger" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A PO who cannot decide is not a PO — they are a messenger.", what does "messenger" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: messenger /ˈmes.ɪn.dʒər/ (danh từ): người đưa tin. A messenger chỉ chuyển lời; câu nói quen thuộc: don't shoot the messenger.
items.explanationEn: messenger /ˈmes.ɪn.dʒər/ (noun): a person who carries messages. A messenger only passes words along; idiom: don't shoot the messenger.

items.question: Trong câu "every decision takes days; the team loses confidence and starts routing around them; decisions get reversed late when the real authority finally reviews them.", từ "confidence" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "every decision takes days; the team loses confidence and starts routing around them; decisions get reversed late when the real authority finally reviews them.", what does "confidence" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: confidence /ˈkɒn.fɪ.dəns/ (danh từ): lòng tin. Lose confidence in someone = mất lòng tin vào ai; nghĩa khác: in confidence (bí mật).
items.explanationEn: confidence /ˈkɒn.fɪ.dəns/ (noun): trust in someone. Lose confidence in someone means stop trusting them; in confidence means privately.

items.question: Trong câu "every decision takes days; the team loses confidence and starts routing around them; decisions get reversed late when the real authority finally reviews them.", từ "route around" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "every decision takes days; the team loses confidence and starts routing around them; decisions get reversed late when the real authority finally reviews them.", what does "route around" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: route around /ruːt əˈraʊnd/ (cụm từ): đi vòng qua, né. Route around someone = bỏ qua, đi vòng qua người đó để làm việc; gốc từ route (tuyến đường).
items.explanationEn: route around /ruːt əˈraʊnd/ (phrase): to bypass. Route around someone means bypass them to get things done; from route, a path.

items.question: Trong câu "every decision takes days; the team loses confidence and starts routing around them; decisions get reversed late when the real authority finally reviews them.", từ "reverse" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "every decision takes days; the team loses confidence and starts routing around them; decisions get reversed late when the real authority finally reviews them.", what does "reverse" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: reverse /rɪˈvɜːs/ (động từ): đảo ngược, hủy bỏ. Reverse a decision = đảo ngược/hủy quyết định; danh từ reversal.
items.explanationEn: reverse /rɪˈvɜːs/ (verb): to overturn a decision. Reverse a decision means cancel or overturn it; the noun is reversal.

items.question: Trong câu "Several people direct the backlog, each in a different direction.", từ "direct" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Several people direct the backlog, each in a different direction.", what does "direct" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: direct /daɪˈrekt/ (động từ): chỉ đạo, điều hành. Direct the backlog/a team = chỉ đạo backlog/nhóm; danh từ direction (hướng, chỉ đạo).
items.explanationEn: direct /daɪˈrekt/ (verb): to control or manage. Direct the backlog or a team means control it; the noun is direction.

items.question: Trong câu "When the product misses its goal, everyone can point out that their own part was done correctly.", từ "point out" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When the product misses its goal, everyone can point out that their own part was done correctly.", what does "point out" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: point out /pɔɪnt aʊt/ (cụm từ): chỉ ra. Point out that... = chỉ ra rằng...; point out a mistake = chỉ ra lỗi.
items.explanationEn: point out /pɔɪnt aʊt/ (phrase): to draw attention to. Point out that something is true; e.g. point out a mistake.

items.question: Trong câu "many stakeholders may contribute, but there must be one person who settles the order and a clear process for resolving their disagreements.", từ "contribute" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "many stakeholders may contribute, but there must be one person who settles the order and a clear process for resolving their disagreements.", what does "contribute" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: contribute /kənˈtrɪb.juːt/ (động từ): đóng góp. Contribute to something = đóng góp vào; danh từ contribution, người đóng góp contributor.
items.explanationEn: contribute /kənˈtrɪb.juːt/ (verb): to give input or help. Contribute to something means add to it; nouns: contribution, contributor.

items.question: Trong câu "many stakeholders may contribute, but there must be one person who settles the order and a clear process for resolving their disagreements.", từ "settle" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "many stakeholders may contribute, but there must be one person who settles the order and a clear process for resolving their disagreements.", what does "settle" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: settle /ˈset.əl/ (động từ): chốt, giải quyết dứt điểm. Settle the order/a dispute = chốt thứ tự/giải quyết tranh chấp.
items.explanationEn: settle /ˈset.əl/ (verb): to decide finally. Settle the order or a dispute means decide it for good.

items.question: Trong câu "many stakeholders may contribute, but there must be one person who settles the order and a clear process for resolving their disagreements.", từ "resolve" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "many stakeholders may contribute, but there must be one person who settles the order and a clear process for resolving their disagreements.", what does "resolve" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: resolve /rɪˈzɒlv/ (động từ): giải quyết. Resolve a disagreement/an issue = giải quyết bất đồng/vấn đề; danh từ resolution.
items.explanationEn: resolve /rɪˈzɒlv/ (verb): to find a solution to. Resolve a disagreement or issue; the noun is resolution.

items.question: Trong câu "many stakeholders may contribute, but there must be one person who settles the order and a clear process for resolving their disagreements.", từ "disagreement" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "many stakeholders may contribute, but there must be one person who settles the order and a clear process for resolving their disagreements.", what does "disagreement" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: disagreement /ˌdɪs.əˈɡriː.mənt/ (danh từ): sự bất đồng. Resolve disagreements = giải quyết bất đồng; động từ disagree with.
items.explanationEn: disagreement /ˌdɪs.əˈɡriː.mənt/ (noun): a difference of opinion. Resolve disagreements between people; the verb is disagree with.

items.question: Trong câu "The PO must protect the backlog's integrity; accepting everything means prioritizing nothing", từ "integrity" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The PO must protect the backlog's integrity; accepting everything means prioritizing nothing", what does "integrity" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: the state of being whole and sound
items.explanation: integrity /ɪnˈteɡ.rə.ti/ (danh từ): tính toàn vẹn, nhất quán. Protect the backlog's integrity = giữ backlog nhất quán, không bị nhồi mọi yêu cầu; data integrity = toàn vẹn dữ liệu.
items.explanationEn: integrity /ɪnˈteɡ.rə.ti/ (noun): the state of being whole and sound. Protect the backlog's integrity means keep it sound and coherent; compare data integrity.

items.question: Trong câu "Crossing it in either direction causes harm.", từ "harm" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Crossing it in either direction causes harm.", what does "harm" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: harm /hɑːm/ (danh từ): tác hại. Cause harm = gây hại; tính từ harmful, harmless.
items.explanationEn: harm /hɑːm/ (noun): damage. Cause harm means do damage; adjectives harmful, harmless.

items.question: Trong câu "Attend the daily standup — listen for anyone blocked by a missing decision or missing information.", từ "attend" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Attend the daily standup — listen for anyone blocked by a missing decision or missing information.", what does "attend" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: attend /əˈtend/ (động từ): tham dự. Attend a meeting = tham dự cuộc họp (không có to); attend to something = xử lý việc gì.
items.explanationEn: attend /əˈtend/ (verb): to be present at. Attend a meeting takes no preposition; attend to something means deal with it.

items.question: Trong câu "Attend the daily standup — listen for anyone blocked by a missing decision or missing information.", từ "listen for" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Attend the daily standup — listen for anyone blocked by a missing decision or missing information.", what does "listen for" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: listen for /ˈlɪs.ən fɔːr/ (cụm từ): lắng nghe để phát hiện. Listen for problems = chú ý nghe để bắt được vấn đề; khác listen to (nghe ai).
items.explanationEn: listen for /ˈlɪs.ən fɔːr/ (phrase): to listen to notice something. Listen for problems means pay attention to catch them; different from listen to.

items.question: Trong câu "Answer outstanding backlog questions.", từ "outstanding" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Answer outstanding backlog questions.", what does "outstanding" (adjective) mean?
options: còn tồn đọng, chưa xử lý
items.explanation: outstanding /ˌaʊtˈstæn.dɪŋ/ (tính từ): còn tồn đọng, chưa xử lý. Outstanding questions/tasks = câu hỏi/việc còn tồn; nghĩa khác: outstanding work = xuất sắc.
items.explanationEn: outstanding /ˌaʊtˈstæn.dɪŋ/ (adjective): not yet dealt with. Outstanding questions or tasks are still open; another sense is excellent, as in outstanding work.

items.question: Trong câu "Do this before anything else, because every unanswered question is someone blocked or about to guess.", từ "about to" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Do this before anything else, because every unanswered question is someone blocked or about to guess.", what does "about to" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: about to /əˈbaʊt tuː/ (cụm từ): sắp sửa. Be about to do something = sắp làm gì; about to guess = sắp phải đoán.
items.explanationEn: about to /əˈbaʊt tuː/ (phrase): on the point of. Be about to do something means very soon; e.g. about to guess.

items.question: Trong câu "Talk to users or customers — the activity most easily dropped when busy, and the most important in the long run.", từ "drop" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Talk to users or customers — the activity most easily dropped when busy, and the most important in the long run.", what does "drop" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: drop /drɒp/ (động từ): bỏ qua, gác lại. Drop a task/feature = bỏ việc/tính năng; nghĩa khác: drop by (ghé qua).
items.explanationEn: drop /drɒp/ (verb): to stop doing or abandon. Drop a task or feature means abandon it; another use is drop by, meaning visit.

items.question: Trong câu "Talk to users or customers — the activity most easily dropped when busy, and the most important in the long run.", từ "in the long run" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Talk to users or customers — the activity most easily dropped when busy, and the most important in the long run.", what does "in the long run" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: in the long run /ɪn ðə lɒŋ rʌn/ (cụm từ): về lâu dài. In the long run = về lâu dài; trái nghĩa: in the short term.
items.explanationEn: in the long run /ɪn ðə lɒŋ rʌn/ (phrase): over a long period. In the long run means eventually, over time; the opposite is in the short term.

items.question: Trong câu "Backlog grooming with the BA and team: splitting epics, clarifying stories, adding acceptance criteria.", từ "grooming" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Backlog grooming with the BA and team: splitting epics, clarifying stories, adding acceptance criteria.", what does "grooming" (noun) mean?
options: việc làm rõ, sắp xếp backlog
items.explanation: grooming /ˈɡruː.mɪŋ/ (danh từ): việc làm rõ, sắp xếp backlog. Backlog grooming là tên cũ của backlog refinement; nghĩa đời thường là chải chuốt.
items.explanationEn: grooming /ˈɡruː.mɪŋ/ (noun): tidying and refining a backlog. Backlog grooming is the older name for backlog refinement; in daily life it means personal care.

items.question: Trong câu "Look at usage data to see whether what shipped is actually being used.", từ "usage" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Look at usage data to see whether what shipped is actually being used.", what does "usage" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: usage /ˈjuː.sɪdʒ/ (danh từ): mức độ sử dụng. Usage data = dữ liệu về việc sử dụng; nghĩa khác: English usage (cách dùng từ).
items.explanationEn: usage /ˈjuː.sɪdʒ/ (noun): how much something is used. Usage data shows how much a product is used; another sense is English usage.

items.question: Trong câu "A health indicator: if you cannot find time to talk to real users in a given week, you are becoming a backlog administrator rather than a product owner.", từ "indicator" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A health indicator: if you cannot find time to talk to real users in a given week, you are becoming a backlog administrator rather than a product owner.", what does "indicator" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a sign that shows a state
items.explanation: indicator /ˈɪn.dɪ.keɪ.tər/ (danh từ): chỉ báo, dấu hiệu. A health indicator = chỉ báo sức khỏe (của vai trò/dự án); cụm: key performance indicator (KPI).
items.explanationEn: indicator /ˈɪn.dɪ.keɪ.tər/ (noun): a sign that shows a state. A health indicator shows how well something is going; compare key performance indicator.

items.question: Trong câu "A health indicator: if you cannot find time to talk to real users in a given week, you are becoming a backlog administrator rather than a product owner.", từ "rather than" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A health indicator: if you cannot find time to talk to real users in a given week, you are becoming a backlog administrator rather than a product owner.", what does "rather than" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: rather than /ˈrɑː.ðər ðæn/ (cụm từ): thay vì, chứ không phải. A rather than B = A chứ không phải B; nhấn mạnh sự lựa chọn.
items.explanationEn: rather than /ˈrɑː.ðər ðæn/ (phrase): instead of. A rather than B means A instead of B; it stresses the choice.

items.question: Trong câu "A PO receives far more requests than can be delivered.", từ "far" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A PO receives far more requests than can be delivered.", what does "far" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: far /fɑːr/ (trạng từ): nhiều, hơn hẳn. Far more/far better = nhiều hơn hẳn/tốt hơn hẳn; so far = cho đến nay.
items.explanationEn: far /fɑːr/ (adverb): by a great amount. Far more or far better means much more; so far means until now.

items.question: Trong câu "Judging an item by real business value, not by who asked or who spoke loudest.", từ "judge" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Judging an item by real business value, not by who asked or who spoke loudest.", what does "judge" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: judge /dʒʌdʒ/ (động từ): đánh giá. Judge an item by its value = đánh giá mục backlog theo giá trị; danh từ judgement.
items.explanationEn: judge /dʒʌdʒ/ (verb): to form an opinion about. Judge an item by its value means assess it on that basis; the noun is judgement.

items.question: Trong câu "You must decide with incomplete information, and some decisions will be wrong.", từ "incomplete" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "You must decide with incomplete information, and some decisions will be wrong.", what does "incomplete" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: incomplete /ˌɪn.kəmˈpliːt/ (tính từ): không đầy đủ. Decide with incomplete information = quyết định khi thông tin chưa đầy đủ.
items.explanationEn: incomplete /ˌɪn.kəmˈpliːt/ (adjective): not whole or finished. Decide with incomplete information means decide before you know everything.

items.question: Trong câu "What matters is deciding quickly and being willing to correct when new evidence appears.", từ "willing" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "What matters is deciding quickly and being willing to correct when new evidence appears.", what does "willing" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: willing /ˈwɪl.ɪŋ/ (tính từ): sẵn lòng. Be willing to do something = sẵn lòng làm gì; danh từ willingness.
items.explanationEn: willing /ˈwɪl.ɪŋ/ (adjective): ready to do something. Be willing to do something means be ready to; the noun is willingness.

items.question: Trong câu "What matters is deciding quickly and being willing to correct when new evidence appears.", từ "evidence" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "What matters is deciding quickly and being willing to correct when new evidence appears.", what does "evidence" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: evidence /ˈev.ɪ.dəns/ (danh từ): bằng chứng. New evidence = bằng chứng mới; là danh từ không đếm được: a piece of evidence.
items.explanationEn: evidence /ˈev.ɪ.dəns/ (noun): facts showing something is true. New evidence is new supporting facts; it is uncountable: a piece of evidence.

items.question: Trong câu "Conveying the vision down to the team and technical reality up to stakeholders.", từ "convey" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Conveying the vision down to the team and technical reality up to stakeholders.", what does "convey" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: convey /kənˈveɪ/ (động từ): truyền đạt. Convey the vision/a message = truyền đạt tầm nhìn/thông điệp.
items.explanationEn: convey /kənˈveɪ/ (verb): to communicate an idea. Convey the vision or a message means get it across.

items.question: Trong câu "Enough domain knowledge to distinguish what genuinely matters to users.", từ "domain" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Enough domain knowledge to distinguish what genuinely matters to users.", what does "domain" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: domain /dəˈmeɪn/ (danh từ): lĩnh vực nghiệp vụ. Domain knowledge = kiến thức nghiệp vụ (ngân hàng, y tế...); trong IT còn là tên miền.
items.explanationEn: domain /dəˈmeɪn/ (noun): a business field of knowledge. Domain knowledge is expertise in a business area such as banking; in IT it also means a web address.

items.question: Trong câu "Enough domain knowledge to distinguish what genuinely matters to users.", từ "distinguish" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Enough domain knowledge to distinguish what genuinely matters to users.", what does "distinguish" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: distinguish /dɪˈstɪŋ.ɡwɪʃ/ (động từ): phân biệt. Distinguish A from B / between A and B = phân biệt A với B; đừng nhầm với extinguish (dập tắt).
items.explanationEn: distinguish /dɪˈstɪŋ.ɡwɪʃ/ (verb): to tell apart. Distinguish A from B or between A and B; do not confuse it with extinguish.

items.question: Trong câu "The most underrated skill: willingness to admit a previous decision was wrong.", từ "admit" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The most underrated skill: willingness to admit a previous decision was wrong.", what does "admit" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: admit /ədˈmɪt/ (động từ): thừa nhận. Admit (that) a decision was wrong = thừa nhận quyết định sai; danh từ admission.
items.explanationEn: admit /ədˈmɪt/ (verb): to accept as true. Admit that a decision was wrong means accept it; the noun is admission.

items.question: Trong câu "A PO who defends an old decision merely because they made it will steer the product wrong for longer than necessary.", từ "defend" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A PO who defends an old decision merely because they made it will steer the product wrong for longer than necessary.", what does "defend" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: defend /dɪˈfend/ (động từ): bảo vệ, bênh vực. Defend a decision = bênh vực quyết định; danh từ defence (Mỹ: defense).
items.explanationEn: defend /dɪˈfend/ (verb): to argue in support of. Defend a decision means argue for it; the noun is defence, or defense in US English.

items.question: Trong câu "On complex products, PO and BA are complementary roles, not competing ones.", từ "complementary" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "On complex products, PO and BA are complementary roles, not competing ones.", what does "complementary" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: complementary /ˌkɒm.plɪˈmen.tər.i/ (tính từ): bổ sung cho nhau. Complementary roles = vai trò bổ trợ nhau; đừng nhầm complimentary (miễn phí, khen ngợi).
items.explanationEn: complementary /ˌkɒm.plɪˈmen.tər.i/ (adjective): completing each other. Complementary roles complete each other; do not confuse with complimentary, meaning free or praising.

items.question: Trong câu "On complex products, PO and BA are complementary roles, not competing ones.", từ "competing" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "On complex products, PO and BA are complementary roles, not competing ones.", what does "competing" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: competing /kəmˈpiː.tɪŋ/ (tính từ): cạnh tranh nhau. Competing roles/priorities = vai trò/ưu tiên cạnh tranh nhau; động từ compete.
items.explanationEn: competing /kəmˈpiː.tɪŋ/ (adjective): rivalling each other. Competing roles or priorities rival each other; the verb is compete.

items.question: Trong câu "On complex products, PO and BA are complementary roles, not competing ones.", từ "complex" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "On complex products, PO and BA are complementary roles, not competing ones.", what does "complex" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: complex /ˈkɒm.pleks/ (tính từ): phức tạp. Complex products = sản phẩm phức tạp; danh từ complex còn là khu phức hợp hoặc mặc cảm.
items.explanationEn: complex /ˈkɒm.pleks/ (adjective): having many connected parts. Complex products have many parts; the noun complex can mean a building group or a hang-up.

items.question: Trong câu "Analyses to clarify value", từ "clarify" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Analyses to clarify value", what does "clarify" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: clarify /ˈklær.ɪ.faɪ/ (động từ): làm rõ. Clarify value/requirements = làm rõ giá trị/yêu cầu; danh từ clarification.
items.explanationEn: clarify /ˈklær.ɪ.faɪ/ (verb): to make clearer. Clarify value or requirements means make them clear; the noun is clarification.

items.question: Trong câu "Eliciting detail from users", từ "elicit" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Eliciting detail from users", what does "elicit" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: elicit /iˈlɪs.ɪt/ (động từ): khai thác (thông tin). Elicit requirements = khai thác yêu cầu từ người dùng; đừng nhầm với illicit (bất hợp pháp).
items.explanationEn: elicit /iˈlɪs.ɪt/ (verb): to draw out information. Elicit requirements means draw them out of people; do not confuse with illicit, meaning illegal.

items.question: Trong câu "The most effective pattern for complex products: the PO owns VALUE and ORDER, the BA owns DETAIL and MODELING.", từ "effective" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The most effective pattern for complex products: the PO owns VALUE and ORDER, the BA owns DETAIL and MODELING.", what does "effective" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: effective /ɪˈfek.tɪv/ (tính từ): hiệu quả. Effective pattern = cách làm hiệu quả; nghĩa khác: effective from 1 May (có hiệu lực từ).
items.explanationEn: effective /ɪˈfek.tɪv/ (adjective): producing the wanted result. An effective pattern gets results; another sense is effective from 1 May.

items.question: Trong câu "The most effective pattern for complex products: the PO owns VALUE and ORDER, the BA owns DETAIL and MODELING.", từ "pattern" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The most effective pattern for complex products: the PO owns VALUE and ORDER, the BA owns DETAIL and MODELING.", what does "pattern" (noun) mean?
options: mô hình, cách làm lặp lại
items.explanation: pattern /ˈpæt.ən/ (danh từ): mô hình, cách làm lặp lại. Pattern = cách làm/mô hình được lặp lại; cụm: design pattern.
items.explanationEn: pattern /ˈpæt.ən/ (noun): a repeated way of working. A pattern is a repeatable way of doing things; e.g. design pattern.

items.question: Trong câu "The most effective pattern for complex products: the PO owns VALUE and ORDER, the BA owns DETAIL and MODELING.", từ "own" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The most effective pattern for complex products: the PO owns VALUE and ORDER, the BA owns DETAIL and MODELING.", what does "own" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: own /əʊn/ (động từ): chịu trách nhiệm chính về. Own the backlog/value = làm chủ, chịu trách nhiệm về backlog/giá trị; danh từ owner, ownership.
items.explanationEn: own /əʊn/ (verb): to be responsible for. Own the backlog or value means be responsible for it; nouns: owner, ownership.

items.question: Trong câu "This frees the PO from drowning in detail so they have time for the most important work — talking to users and steering the product.", từ "free" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This frees the PO from drowning in detail so they have time for the most important work — talking to users and steering the product.", what does "free" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: free /friː/ (động từ): giải phóng, giải thoát. Free someone from something = giải phóng ai khỏi việc gì; free up time = dành ra thời gian.
items.explanationEn: free /friː/ (verb): to release from a burden. Free someone from something releases them; free up time means make time available.

items.question: Trong câu "This frees the PO from drowning in detail so they have time for the most important work — talking to users and steering the product.", từ "drown in" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This frees the PO from drowning in detail so they have time for the most important work — talking to users and steering the product.", what does "drown in" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: drown in /draʊn ɪn/ (cụm từ): ngập đầu trong (việc). Drown in detail/work = ngập đầu trong chi tiết/công việc; nghĩa đen: chết đuối.
items.explanationEn: drown in /draʊn ɪn/ (phrase): to be overwhelmed by. Drown in detail or work means be overwhelmed; literally it means die in water.

items.question: Trong câu "This frees the PO from drowning in detail so they have time for the most important work — talking to users and steering the product.", từ "steer" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This frees the PO from drowning in detail so they have time for the most important work — talking to users and steering the product.", what does "steer" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: steer /stɪər/ (động từ): định hướng, dẫn dắt. Steer the product = định hướng sản phẩm; steer clear of = tránh xa.
items.explanationEn: steer /stɪər/ (verb): to guide the direction of. Steer the product means guide its direction; steer clear of means avoid.

items.question: Trong câu "The PO role revolves around one question: what should we build next, and why?", từ "revolve around" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The PO role revolves around one question: what should we build next, and why?", what does "revolve around" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: revolve around /rɪˈvɒlv əˈraʊnd/ (cụm từ): xoay quanh. Revolve around X = xoay quanh X, lấy X làm trọng tâm.
items.explanationEn: revolve around /rɪˈvɒlv əˈraʊnd/ (phrase): to be centred on. Revolve around X means have X as the central focus.

items.question: Trong câu "Authority and availability are the two preconditions — missing either breaks the role.", từ "availability" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Authority and availability are the two preconditions — missing either breaks the role.", what does "availability" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: availability /əˌveɪ.ləˈbɪl.ə.ti/ (danh từ): sự sẵn sàng hỗ trợ. Availability của PO = luôn có mặt để trả lời; trong IT, availability = độ sẵn sàng của hệ thống.
items.explanationEn: availability /əˌveɪ.ləˈbɪl.ə.ti/ (noun): being reachable to help. A PO's availability means being reachable to answer; in IT it means system uptime.

items.question: Trong câu "Authority and availability are the two preconditions — missing either breaks the role.", từ "precondition" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Authority and availability are the two preconditions — missing either breaks the role.", what does "precondition" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: precondition /ˌpriː.kənˈdɪʃ.ən/ (danh từ): điều kiện tiên quyết. A precondition for success = điều kiện tiên quyết để thành công; gần nghĩa prerequisite.
items.explanationEn: precondition /ˌpriː.kənˈdɪʃ.ən/ (noun): something needed first. A precondition for success must be in place first; similar to prerequisite.

items.question: Trong câu "The three failure modes — absence, no authority, committee — account for most ineffective Scrum.", từ "account for" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The three failure modes — absence, no authority, committee — account for most ineffective Scrum.", what does "account for" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: account for /əˈkaʊnt fɔːr/ (cụm từ): chiếm, là nguyên nhân của. Account for most X = chiếm phần lớn/giải thích phần lớn X; nghĩa khác: account for a delay (giải trình).
items.explanationEn: account for /əˈkaʊnt fɔːr/ (phrase): to make up or cause. Account for most X means make up or cause most of it; another sense is explain, as in account for a delay.

items.question: Trong câu "The three failure modes — absence, no authority, committee — account for most ineffective Scrum.", từ "ineffective" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The three failure modes — absence, no authority, committee — account for most ineffective Scrum.", what does "ineffective" (adjective) mean?
options: không có hiệu lực pháp lý
items.explanation: ineffective /ˌɪn.ɪˈfek.tɪv/ (tính từ): kém hiệu quả. Ineffective Scrum = Scrum áp dụng kém hiệu quả; trái nghĩa effective.
items.explanationEn: ineffective /ˌɪn.ɪˈfek.tɪv/ (adjective): not producing results. Ineffective Scrum fails to produce results; the opposite is effective.
